notes.title: Happy New Year to everyone at the Rich Party!
notes.content:
The Rich Party Working Group is here to give everyone a New Year's greeting in advance, wishing everyone a happy New Year and a happy day!

Then I will report the situation to everyone:

Currently, due to some personnel adjustments, only 2 developers are continuing to follow up and are still working part-time

The biggest problem with the game at present is the occasional freezing situation, and the framework is currently being adjusted

3. The framework adjustment involves a lot of things, so the game has not been updated for a long time. It is expected that there will be version updates in the next 2-3 months

Thank you all for your support of the Rich Party!

notes.content:

notes.title: [Rich Party fixed and updated on August 16th.
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback! After the remastered version was launched, we have been repairing and optimizing the game. The following are the updated details for today's fix.
1. AI has added the use of cards (currently only directional cards are open)

2. AI can now buy cards in stores/earn points in mini games

3. Fixed the issue where hosting AI in prisons/hospitals/hotels would cause synchronization issues when online

4. Fixed the bug caused by using the random card after selecting the direction

5. Fixed bugs during the hosting of the research institute

6. Fixed bugs related to prison events and anti card conflicts in the Magic House and News

7. Fixed the bug that triggered anti card blocking during bankruptcy, causing the card to freeze

8. Optimized some performance

9. Temporarily removed the scapegoat card with more issues and conducted more detailed debugging before releasing it

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

If you have any questions or suggestions, you can join the bug group 858098627 for feedback, and we will definitely reply to your questions in a timely manner!

notes.title: [Rich Party fixed and updated on July 17th.
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback! After the remastered version was launched, we have been repairing and optimizing the game. The following are the updated details for today's fix.
1. Added chat within the game center (up to 40 words per session)

2. After the countdown has ended, it's time to roll the dice now

3. The remote end can see the countdown of the current action character

4. Optimized the handling method for the "next round" and solved the occasional situation of multi terminal asynchrony in the next round

5. Solved the occasional bug of 'unable to use card'

6. Add cards: Eternal Sleep&Dream of a Yellow Beam

7. Add immortals: building cows, unlucky mice, and confused sheep

8. Now it is allowed to change the size of the game window by pulling

9. Optimized the lighting and game visibility of the scene

10. Further improved the game rhythm and competitiveness

11. Optimized the performance details of AI remotely when online

12. Several other minor bugs
If you have any questions or suggestions, you can join the bug group 858098627 for feedback, and we will definitely reply to your questions in a timely manner!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/97ccadc868ebac1761b7475cb0834dc9ffbaafdb.png[/img]

notes.title: [Rich Party fixed and updated on July 10th.
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback! After the remastered version was launched, we have been repairing and optimizing the game. The following are the updated details for today's fix.
1. Occasional issues with game lag caused by incorrect pop ups in hospitals and prisons

notes.title: Free Remake Update!
notes.content:
Free Remake Update! The remastered version of "Rich Party" is officially launched!
After nine months of remake, we are pleased to announce the launch of the remastered version of "Rich Party"! Thank you all for your support!
For players who have already purchased "Rich Party", it can be updated for free without the need to purchase again! After the game is remade, it will bring new substantive content, including new skins, new vehicles, the gameplay of the initial creative workshop (specifically Steam Workshop), achievement system, task system, and so on. After the update of the Creative Workshop, players can freely combine the components we have prepared, create new maps, and design new gameplay. The remastered version will also comprehensively optimize game performance, voice over optimization, and add exclusive BGM to each image. A brand new theme song will also be launched. Our sincerity is full, all for improving the player experience.
The remastered version will be discounted by 20% in the first week of launch! You can pay more attention to our social media, and there will be more activities continuously updated on social media platforms in the future!
Thank you all for your support and love! If you have any questions, you can join the official community for feedback or leave a message on social media!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/70ff0c8c26869d655486d7eab0f6c24d8ae4ffce.png[/img]

notes.title: RICH PARTY team wishes everyone a happy new year!
notes.content:
RICH PARTY team wishes everyone a happy new year! Good health! Family happiness! Thank you very much for your support of Rich Party!  Rich Party has not been updated for 5 months, but the production team has not stopped working and WE are  currently remaking the party. Simply put, we are redoing it, and the remake will comprehensively optimize the game.
What we did during 5 months: 
1.We remade the program framework so that we can deal with the malignant bug of our previous stuck interrupt game. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/e61002a5eabb9407747ebbeba3000955474d1a73.png[/img]
2. STEAM Workshop ! (Currently still an internal editor)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/b61afe0042017ae3dd07b64611f3d376d603ac22.png[/img]
3.has optimized almost all art.  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/97eeb33173d278d5415886f192cb13ec73420fd0.png[/img]
4. Optimized  all character dubbing. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/22b68ba658ebeaeb1f212a65074702612b9d92c3.png[/img]
5. What have we done with players recently.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094418/f6186562535e1cafb60b46e4e240aa2d179efdfa.png[/img]
The situation is very complicated, and our small studio is working overtime to push forward. The completion time of the remake will definitely be after the new year. After completion, we will open testing in advance! The remastered "Rich Party" will be updated on the original basis (i.e. players who own the game can directly update it).  Rich Party launched on August 15th, a special day, and it is also a meaningful work for small teams. I hope more friends will join the game after the remake

notes.title: Happy MidAutumn Festival and National Day to all players
notes.content:
Dear players,

The festival is approaching, and the production team wishes everyone a happy Mid Autumn and National Day! To celebrate the Double Festivals, the "Rich Party" will hold a 60% discount at 12:00 noon on September 27, 2023. Welcome players to join the "Rich Party" family! The game will have a front-end update on September 27, 2023 at 16:00 pm, with the following specific updates:

1. Optimize local mode AI logic

2. Optimize explosive detonation logic

3. Optimize buff display logic

4. Optimize the logic of using prop cards

5. Optimize the logic of immortal effects

6. Optimize the logic for entering the game Ui

7. Add the Enter shortcut key for game chat

Thank you for your support and understanding. The production team will be dedicated to serving everyone in the game. If you encounter any problems in the game, you can add the official QQ group: 224984920 or send suggestions and opinions to your email 2099310972@qq.com Provide feedback. Welcome everyone to give feedback!
